## Thesis

McDermott, C. (2026). *Impact of Temporal Structure and Duration of Actigraphy
on ADHD Prediction with Fair and Interpretable Machine Learning*. MSc
Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence, University of York.

Machine learning on accelerometry from 5,033 children in the Millennium Cohort
Study, testing whether intra-daily and weekly activity patterns predict ADHD,
and how many days of monitoring are needed. Awarded 80.

[Full thesis (PDF)](projects/msc-thesis/thesis.pdf) ·
